## What could happen

One or two sentences: who could do what, to whose money, books, or secrets.

## How

The path, step by step, as far as it is known.

## Rule

The charter rule it bends (SEC-NN), or "new rule" with the one sentence it would add.

## Done when

The test that fails today and passes after the fix, marked with the rule.
